## Production Deployments

### Agentic AI Document Review (Fortune 500 · Enterprise AI)
AWS serverless pipeline automating compliance review of 200+ page documents against style guides and rubrics.
Architecture: S3 → EventBridge → Step Functions → 5 Lambda stages (pdf_extract, chunk_plan, kendra_retrieve, bedrock_review, aggregate_render) → Kendra GenAI RAG → Bedrock (Claude 3.5 Haiku, temperature=0.0).
Key decisions: coverage gating (100% chunk completion before report), deterministic S3 key layout (no database), JSON schema enforcement + repair prompt, SSE-KMS encryption, IAM least-privilege.
Outcome: 60–80% reduction in manual review effort. Modular patterns now reference architecture across the division.

### ScholarPath (Ed-Tech · Live in Production)
Multi-tenant SaaS for Maharashtra MSCE scholarship exam preparation.
Stack: React 18 + TypeScript + FastAPI + Supabase + Razorpay. Parent-as-gateway permission model.
URL: https://scholarpath-app.web.app
Outcome: 1,000+ students, 124-test E2E suite, live with paying customers.

### OmmSai (Healthcare AI · Open Source)
Python LLM pipeline processing 15,000+ handwritten prescription PDFs for a charitable healthcare event.
Stack: Claude API + Google Drive API + ThreadPoolExecutor (8 workers) + Tkinter GUI.
Hard problem: confidence calibration on illegible medical handwriting — built eval harness with 200-prescription hold-out set, 0.85 confidence threshold gating.
GitHub: https://github.com/ramdhavepreetam/OmmSai
Outcome: 15,247 PDFs in 47.5 hours, 99.97% accuracy, $0 cost.

### JapaApp (Spiritual-Tech · Live in Production)
Offline-first PWA for Vedic mantra practice. Firebase Custom Claims, Razorpay donation tiers with Sanskrit naming.
URL: https://dojapa.com
Status: Live in production

### IBKR Futures Automation (Fintech · Working Prototype)
NLP-driven command interface for futures and vertical spread options trading.
Stack: Python + ib_insync + Claude API (structured output command parsing) + React dashboard.
Hard problem: eval harness for command interpretation accuracy before live deployment.

### Secure Vendor Integration Platform (Enterprise · Shipped)
Cross-account S3 file distribution for Fortune 500 parts & pricing division.
Stack: AWS Transfer Family (SFTP) + KMS + IAM cross-account + Lambda. Per-partner home-directory isolation.

## Playbook Frameworks

1. The 4-Question Scoping Doc — Before touching code: who is the user, what's the worst-case failure, what does good enough look like, what can't I build?
2. Eval-First AI Shipping — Write evals before features. Golden set methodology. Harnesses that survive production.
3. The Production AI Checklist — 12 things demos hide: rate limits, retry logic, prompt versioning, eval drift, cost monitoring, coverage gates, failure manifests.
4. Spec-First Engineering — TID + ADR methodology. No spec, no code.
5. When to Deploy a 7B Model Instead of Calling Claude — Cost-quality trade-off framework (active research track).
